D018-D002_h025.question: "It’s just…everything feels so overwhelming lately. I try to focus on my writing, but my mind just drifts. I’ve always been a bit scattered, even as a kid, like before middle school, you know? My teachers would always say I was a dreamer. Now, I'll be staring at a blank page, and then suddenly, I’ll be back there, reliving... that day. It replays in my head, over and over, these awful images I can’t shake. And then, I'll snap at my ex-husband, or even my friends, just yelling and cursing over the smallest things. I feel this constant shame, like I'm fundamentally flawed. Even when I finish a big project, there’s no real sense of accomplishment, just emptiness. It’s been like this for months, this heavy feeling, and no matter how hard I try, I can't seem to break free from it."

    B. Acute Stress Disorder
    C. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
